## 📦 Featured Package: {coresynth}

::: {.coresynth-banner}
### Fast Synthetic Control Methods in R

::: {.badges}
[![CRAN status](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/coresynth)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=coresynth)
[![dev version](https://img.shields.io/github/r-package/v/yo5uke/coresynth?label=dev%20version&color=blue)](https://github.com/yo5uke/coresynth)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/yo5uke/coresynth/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/yo5uke/coresynth/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
:::

::: {.coresynth-lead}
**{coresynth}** provides a high-performance, unified interface for the **Synthetic Control Method (SCM)** and its modern extensions. By moving computational bottlenecks to C++ via `RcppArmadillo`, it achieves significant speedups compared to pure-R alternatives—making iterative inference and simulation studies substantially faster.
:::

::: {.coresynth-features}
- **⚡ High Performance**: C++ core delivers substantial speed improvements for heavy optimization routines.
- **🧩 6 Estimators, 1 Interface**: Estimate standard SCM (`scm`), Synthetic DiD (`sdid`), Generalized SCM (`gsc`), Matrix Completion (`mc`), Time-Aware SCM (`tasc`), and Synthetic Interventions (`si`) with a single function `scm_fit()`.
- **🔄 Versatile Adoption Settings**: Native support for both sharp treatment and staggered adoption designs.
- **📊 Comprehensive Workflow**: Built-in methods for visualization (`plot()`), conformal inference (`conformal_inference()`), placebo checks, and JSON export (`export_json()`) for reproducible research.
:::
